information.description:
Kiroshi built a body to show off its optics and found a market: media crews, scouts and surveillance contractors. The Argus sees behind itself and records everything. The company's pitch is that a witness who never blinks is worth any price.

Cost: 14,200eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 38 ([1d6/2] + 11d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Chrome: Amplified Hearing, Audio Recorder, Image Enhance ×2, Low Light/Infrared/UV, MicroVideo, Opti-Zoom, Rear Optical Mount, Scrambler/Descrambler, TeleOptics, Visual Cortex Support

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
